{{Quote|Besides, if you were a Jedi you never could have married Emess.''"<br />"''When we first met, you said she was too young for me.|Bastila and Vaner Shan|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Emess Shan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Revan" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> who was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Vaner Shan]], the son of the renowned [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]]. Emess was younger than Vaner, who had been born in [[3954 BBY]], and Vaner's mother initially disapproved of their relationship on account of her age. By [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], Emess had a son named [[Bress Shan|Bress]] and a younger daughter named [[Reesa Shan|Reesa]], both of whom were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and her husband was running for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. On the anniversary of Bastila's marriage to Revan, Emess and her children accompanied Vaner when he visited his mother, and Emess put her children to bed at the end of the day while Vaner spoke with Bastila.<ref name="Revan" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Emess Shan was first mentioned in the epilogue of [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]]. The introduction of Emess and Vaner's marriage and children confirmed that the [[Shan family]] continued beyond Bastila's son.<ref name="Revan" />
